author: ShadowyShroom
body:
You can use my organization strategy, that I call:

[Circle Organization](https://i.imgur.com/Xd5WXbN.jpg)
When you put shops/beastiaries in huge boxes, it becomes really hard to click individual shops.
Here's a zoomed in shot:

[Zoomed In Base](https://i.imgur.com/TyOZesD.jpg)

You can see that I can access all important buildings in the middle of the screen, and I can pretty easily click on any individual shop/beastiary by rotating my screen.

I usually check my shops with the top of my screen, and beastiaries on the bottom, so I can use the other building as a background, so I can see exclamation marks clearly!

Edit: Spelling, am on phone.
